definition.en: Economic reforms related to industries refer to the structural policy shifts aimed at liberalizing, privatizing, and globalizing the industrial sector to enhance efficiency and competitiveness.
definition.hi: Economic reforms related to industries refer to the structural policy shifts aimed at liberalizing, privatizing, and globalizing the industrial sector to enhance efficiency and competitiveness.

importanceInUpsc.en: These reforms are central to the UPSC GS-3 syllabus as they explain the transition of the Indian economy from a state-controlled model to a market-oriented one. Understanding these changes is crucial for analyzing current industrial policy, ease of doing business, and long-term economic growth trajectories.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the shift from the License Raj to a liberalized industrial framework.
